versions.changelog:
Initial release of au-bas-gst-advisor: An expert BAS and GST triage assistant for Australian businesses.

- Explains every BAS field (G1–G11, 1A, 1B, W1–W5, T1–T8) and relevant GST rules.
- Diagnoses and guides on GST registration, supply classification (taxable, GST-free, input-taxed), and BAS lodgement cycles.
- Flags common BAS anomalies and potential ATO audit triggers.
- Provides step-by-step correction, penalty, and amendment instructions.
- Knowledge is based on the GST Act 1999, ATO rulings, and up-to-date public ATO guidance.
- All logic is self-contained; no external integrations required.
